rules.condition: queue.size() >= kRespawnMaxQueueEntries; victim = first kind==1; victim == end -> return; after evict-fire size still >= cap -> pop_back
rules.semantic: The respawn queue is capped (the snapshot serializer's limit). A new corpse at the cap evicts the OLDEST queued bot, firing it immediately (its replacement is fielded now instead of later) so the roster never shrinks; if only players are queued the newcomer is refused (players are never evicted for anyone). If the evicted bot's fire was blocked and re-queued itself, that retry is dropped instead of the newcomer. In a scripted mode the eviction fire never dispatches on_respawn (see respawn.cpp:423: only the timer fire does).
